goal: - Diwali 2050 mein AI se banaye decoration aayenge. Holographic rangoli aur drone shows dekhne ko bahut hi interesting honge.

- Diwali ke gifts aur snacks robot deliver karengi, aur smart homes mein lighting aur temperature automatically adjust hogi.  AI image generator se festive visuals create karne ke liye text description diya jata hai.
- Holographic rangoli design me bright pink, orange, saffron yellow aur white colors use hongi. Traditional attire waale log sparklers lit karte hue Diwali mood bana sakte hain.
- Virtual celebrations me people online Diwali celebrate kar sakte hain. AI-generated decorations use hongi aur AI video generator se existing festive image ko animate karke video bana sakte hain.

- 2050 mein homes sustainability, technology, adaptability aur wellness se integrate honge. Shree Om Consultant (SOC) sustainable homes design kar raha hai jo client vision ke according customize hota hai.
- 2050 ki Diwali AI aur technology ke upyog se ek exciting aur sustainable celebration hogi.
